item.title: Inside a Model’s Random-Number Fingerprint: A Special Circuit in LLMs
item.dc:creator: Yingjie Tan
item.description: Discussions about GPT “getting worse” and third-party APIs quietly substituting other models never really stop1. A LINUX DO post proposed a simple test: repeatedly ask a model to choose a random number from a fixed range, estimate the output distribution, and use that distribution as a statistical fingerprint of the model.
